s1_observations: After completing prescribed activities, Reflection returns 500 Internal Server Error — diligent student cannot close the educational day or record reflection.
Coverage/progress figures disagree across Home, History, and Export for the same student at the same moment.
Session overview/mission briefing does not tell the student how to use the CMP for this mission (no CMP/Core Reading instruction or page/section cue observable).
claim_question: Can a diligent student confidently entrust Kwalitec with all educational planning while using the CMP exactly as directed?
claim_rationale: Study session Reflection returns HTTP 500 after prescribed activities on LIVE for nearly all journeys (9/9 day-1 cohort + published topics 1.2 and 4.2; Reference IDs captured). Diligent students cannot close the educational day.
Published revision days CA-R1/CB-R1 are loader-live but not reachable via Baseline/early journey.
Unpublished exam-path topic 4.1 still serves fallback Reading without CMP partnership — educational quality is not continuous until examination.

F1/F2 remain closed on published Reading (1.1/1.2/2.1/4.2 certified Guided Reading + CMP checklist PASS) — CMP partnership itself holds where packages exist, but journey completion and exam-horizon continuity fail.
